Release semantics: complete mutation-driven extraction, real Qwen embedding generation, vector persistence, version evidence, and Neo4j vector-query observation are required before Aligned. Provider failure, unapproved provider/model/dimensions, partial generation, partial persistence, vector-index write failure, or query verification failure marks Stale or Failed and prohibits pure semantic queries until restored to Aligned.

Live-provider boundary: W3.1 live E2E requires explicit opt-in in controlled local or protected CI, the approved provider profile qwen3.7-text-embedding at 1024 dimensions, approved secret sources for QWEN_KEY and ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_PASSWORD, and a disposable or protected Neo4j vector index. Offline fakes may support development but cannot be reported as live W3.1 delivery evidence.

Downstream ImplementationDesign must define implementation contracts and test ownership for tests/explicit/entries/runApplyMutationEmbeddingVectorE2E.js, including touched Element/ArchitectureRelationship/View fixtures, real Qwen adapter verification, Neo4j vector queryability, Aligned/Stale/Failed state transitions, pure semantic query rejection, and no-secret-leak evidence.

Human approval evidence: the 2026-07-25 user request explicitly directed the W3.1 integration task and handoff. The handoff schema does not allow an approvedByHuman field, so approval is recorded as schema-compliant acceptanceApproval.W3-1 on grag-wp-3-1 and in this note.
